name: OpenCode
desc_zh: 不绑定模型厂商的开源终端编程智能体
solves: Lets you point the same agent at whichever model provider you hold a key for.
solves_zh: 同一个智能体可以接到你手里有 key 的任意模型厂商。
best_for: You switch model providers and do not want to relearn the agent each time.
best_for_zh: 经常换模型厂商、不想每次重学一个智能体时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Coding-agent gap check against the existing catalogue。来源：https://opencode.ai/
